name: AppNav
description: A consistent navigation header component for applications that includes a customizable app name, navigation links, theme toggle, and mobile support.
usage: Use as the main navigation header at the top of application layouts.
Set the `appName` to display the application title with animation.
Provide `navigationItems` as an array of navigation links configuration.
Optionally add a `toolbar` slot for contextual actions below the main navigation.
Set `scrollAnimation={false}` to disable the scroll effect if needed.
The component automatically integrates with next-auth for handling user sessions.
design: Use the AppNav component at the top of your application layout.
Keep navigation items limited to 5-7 main options for optimal usability.
Always include a sign-out option for authenticated interfaces.
Use the toolbar slot for contextual actions related to the current section.
The header uses backdrop blur and subtle animation for a modern interface feel.
Mobile view automatically adapts to smaller screens with appropriate layout changes.
accessibility: The component uses semantic HTML with the `<header>` element.
Navigation links use proper contrasting colors based on the theme.
Focus states are properly handled for keyboard navigation.
Mobile view maintains usability and touch targets at smaller screen sizes.

props.name: appName
props.description: Application name to display in the header as ASCII art. Must be one of the predefined values.

props.name: navigationItems
props.description: Navigation items to display in the header. Each item includes href, label, optional icon and onClick handler.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Optional toolbar to render below the main navigation for contextual actions.

props.name: scrollAnimation
props.description: Whether to enable animation when scrolling, including backdrop blur and shadow effects.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names to apply to the header element.
